title: TOEIC Speaking: Official Simulation
description: Examen completo de expresión oral (20 min).

parts.visual:
## Speaking Test Instructions 📢

In this section, you will answer 11 questions. For some questions you will have time to prepare. Speak clearly and answer fully.
parts.audio: In this section, you will answer 11 questions. For some questions you will have time to prepare. Speak clearly and answer fully.

parts.visual:
## Questions 1-2: Read Aloud 📢

You will see a text on the screen. You have 45 seconds to prepare. Then you will have 45 seconds to read the text aloud.
parts.audio: You will see a text on the screen. You have 45 seconds to prepare. Then you will have 45 seconds to read the text aloud.

stages.title: Task 1: Read a Text Aloud
sentences: Welcome to the annual tech conference. We are thrilled to have industry leaders from around the globe joining us today. Please ensure that you have your badges visible at all times.
stages.ai_system_prompt: You are a TOEIC examiner. Rate the user's pronunciation, intonation, and stress.

stages.title: Task 2: Read a Text Aloud
sentences: Attention passengers. This is a security announcement. Please do not leave your luggage unattended at any time. Unattended items will be removed by airport security immediately.
stages.ai_system_prompt: You are a TOEIC examiner. Rate the user's pronunciation, intonation, and stress.

parts.visual:
## Question 3: Describe a Picture 📢

You will see a picture. Describe it in as much detail as possible. Focus on Who, What, and Where.
parts.audio: You will see a picture. Describe it in as much detail as possible. Focus on Who, What, and Where.

stages.scenario:
TASK 3: DESCRIBE THE PICTURE

Context: A busy airport terminal with passengers checking in at the counter.
stages.ai_system_prompt: User is describing a picture. Evaluate usage of prepositions and present continuous tense.

parts.visual:
## Questions 4-6: Interview 📢

Imagine that a marketing firm is doing research in your area. You agreed to participate in a telephone interview.
parts.audio: Imagine that a marketing firm is doing research in your area. You agreed to participate in a telephone interview.

stages.scenario:
TASK 4: RESPOND TO QUESTIONS

Question: Describe your ideal work environment.
(Focus on team dynamics and office culture.)
stages.ai_system_prompt: You are an interviewer. Evaluate the candidate's response for coherence, vocabulary and fluency.

stages.scenario:
TASK 5: RESPOND TO QUESTIONS

Question: What do you consider your greatest professional strength?
(Provide a specific example from your past experience.)
stages.ai_system_prompt: You are an interviewer. Evaluate the candidate's response for coherence, vocabulary and fluency.
